rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for happiness or a cheerful state.

example.english: I feel a real sense of cheerfulness today.
example.traditional: 我今日個人覺得好快樂。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 go3 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 faai3 lok6

rows.note: Choose this for a more festive or shared atmosphere of joy rather than an individual’s general happiness.

example.english: The whole venue was full of cheerfulness.
example.jyutping: seng4 go3 wui6 coeng4 dou1 cung1 mun5 fun1 lok6
